messages.content: 在一場撲克遊戲中，確定贏家是誰，約翰手中有8♥、10♥、J♥、Q♥、K♥，邁克手中有9♠、J♠、10♠、Q♠、K♠。

function.name: card_games_poker_determine_winner
function.description: Determines the winner in a game of Poker based on the cards in each players' hands. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

hand1.description: The list of cards (as strings) in first player's hand. E.g ['10♠', 'J♠']

hand2.description: The list of cards (as strings) in second player's hand. E.g ['9♥', '10♥']

message.content:
邁克贏了。  
邁克的牌是 9♠ 10♠ J♠ Q♠ K♠，形成 9‑10‑J‑Q‑K 的同花順；  
約翰的牌是 8♥ 10♥ J♥ Q♥ K♥，雖然也是同花順，但最高牌相同（K），  
比較次高牌時邁克的最低牌是 9，而約翰的最低牌是 8，  
因此邁克的同花順更高，勝出。
message.reasoning:
We need to determine winner. John has 8♥,10♥,J♥,Q♥,K♥. That's a straight flush from 8 to K? Actually 8-10-J-Q-K is a straight flush (8-10-J-Q-K). Mike has 9♠,J♠,10♠,Q♠,K♠. That's also a straight flush from 9 to K? Wait 9-10-J-Q-K is a straight flush. Which is higher? In poker, straight flush ranking: highest card matters. John's highest card is K, but his straight flush starts at 8 and ends at K. Mike's straight flush starts at 9 and ends at K. Both have same high card K. But the lower card matters? Actually ranking of straight flush: compare highest card. If tie, compare next highest? But if both have same high card K, then compare next highest: John's next highest is Q, Mike's next highest is Q as well. Next J vs J, 10 vs 10, 9 vs 8. So Mike's lowest card is 9 vs John's 8. So Mike's straight flush is higher. So Mike wins.

Thus answer: Mike wins.
